modules-for-creating-registries-on-share.text: Modules for creating registries on shared script publications.
Issue 745. This page places the new and changed code and fixes its dependency direction. Records are in the data model and signatures in the functions model.

changed-components.text: Paths are proposals. When the Lean models name a component differently, the code takes the model's name.

dependency-direction.text: The Singular package names no application: the creation command receives the application's scripts from the program that hosts it, as it does today.
